definitions.explanation: A formal or literary reading of 明後日. Used in official announcements, formal writing, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明後日|みょうごにち}⟦{開催|かいさい}されます→開催：noentry⟧。
examples.english: The meeting will be held the day after tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {明後日|みょうごにち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{返答|へんとう}ください→返答：10440_hentou⟧。
examples.english: Please reply by the day after tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発売日|はつばいび}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明後日|みょうごにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The release date is scheduled for the day after tomorrow.

notes:
READING: This word has two readings:
・みょうごにち - formal, official
・あさって - casual, everyday

Both readings use the same kanji 明後日.

USAGE:
・みょうごにち is used in formal announcements, business emails, news reports, and official documents.
・あさって is used in everyday conversation.

REGISTER: Formal/official. In casual speech, use あさって.

RELATED TIME WORDS (formal readings):
・{明日|みょうにち} (tomorrow - formal) vs {明日|あした/あす}
・{昨日|さくじつ} (yesterday - formal) vs {昨日|きのう}
・{本日|ほんじつ} (today - formal) vs {今日|きょう}
